talk_track: I work with independent school boards that can't answer technology-risk questions, usually because IT runs through outside vendors nobody formally oversees. Chapin's open Systems Administrator posting asks that hire to "Collaborate with our Managed Services Providers (MSPs)... and serve as an on-site technical liaison," and to assist with compliance documentation and audit requests. Read together, those two lines put vendor accountability inside one person's daily queue rather than in a reporting line the Board can see. At a tuition-funded school that matters for one reason: when a shared vendor gets breached, schools with written vendor governance recover in days, and schools without it spend weeks managing parent communication -- and across 810 families, weeks is an enrollment number, not an IT number. That's worth knowing whether or not you ever bring in someone like me. Does the Board get a written technology-risk report today? -- Kenneth Thomas
